CONTENT HOLD: Do not quote or list road-tile or CC-lane work details; that section is still being verified. If asked, say the detailed list is under verification.
Candidate: Abhay Singh (Moti Aangli Wale), candidate for Sarpanch, Gram Panchayat Sihali Khurd.
The Gram Panchayat covers Sihali Khurd, Sihali Kalan (Badi Sihali), and Hadahedi; Panchayat Samiti Mundawar, district Khairthal-Tijara, PIN 301401.
Operator-provided service profile: 40 years of public service and community brotherhood.
Polling is Monday, 16 November 2026, from 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM at Government Senior Secondary School, Sihali Khurd.
Booth 95, room 1: wards 1, 2 and 3 of Sihali Khurd.
Booth 96, room 2: wards 4 and 5 of Sihali Khurd plus ward 6 of Sihali Kalan.
Booth 97, room 3: wards 7 and 8 of Sihali Kalan/Badi Sihali.
Booth 98, room 4: wards 9, 10 and 11 of Hadahedi.
Operator-provided official electorate figures: 11 wards, 3,570 voters, 1,863 men, 1,707 women, and 702 voters aged 18-25.
Completed work: Abhay Singh donated ancestral private land for the new sub-health-centre building at Sihali Khurd.
Completed work: Surjan Singh's family was encouraged to donate land for the animal sub-health-centre building at Sihali Kalan.
Completed work: the Sihali Kalan-Hadahedi main road was reconstructed as a paved bitumen road.
Completed work: the road from Baba Kundandas Ashram toward Sihali Kalan was reconstructed and paved.
Completed work: a paved road was built from Baniya Wala Kudi to Baba Mathuradas temple.
Completed work: the road from Hoshiar Singh's shop in Sihali Khurd toward Radwa was widened and paved.
Completed work: a modular library was built in Sihali Khurd for students and young people.
Completed work: a meeting hall was built at Government Senior Secondary School, Sihali Kalan.
Completed work: the roof and floor of a room at Government Upper Primary School, Hadahedi were renovated, and a student toilet was built.
Completed work: the sports ground received about 75 percent boundary-wall coverage, a running track, basketball, badminton and kho-kho courts, and open-gym equipment.
Completed work: JJM water tanks, household tap connections, and drinking-water pipeline expansion were undertaken in Sihali Khurd and Sihali Kalan.

Completed work: six new borewells with motors were installed—two at the cremation ground, one near the Tigawan boundary in Hadahedi, one near Satyaveer Captain's house in Sihali Kalan, one at Baba Kundandas Ashram, and one in the Kumhar settlement of Sihali Kalan.
Completed work at Baba Kundandas Ashram: boundary wall, public toilet, borewell and motor; Amrit Sarovar construction is ongoing.
Completed drainage work: an underground line from Mahipal Tanwar's house toward the pond in Hadahedi.
Completed drainage work: an underground line from the main road toward Rajesh Master's house in Sihali Khurd.
Completed drainage work: a permanent sewer/drain line from Madan Panch's house toward the government school in Hadahedi.
Completed work: traditional ponds and reservoirs in Hadahedi and Sihali Kalan were deepened and restored for rainwater storage.
Completed cremation-ground work: site filling and levelling, two borewells, a water tank, and a regular drinking-water arrangement.
Future commitment: develop sports grounds at Hadahedi and Sihali Kalan and work toward a mini stadium at Sihali Khurd.
Future commitment: complete the remaining household water supply under JJM.
Future commitment: install CCTV at main roads, entrances and junctions, and modern road lighting on main roads and lanes.
Future commitment: establish continuous drainage and permanent cleanliness management.
Future commitment: arrange a regular doctor at the sub-health centre and pursue a sub-health centre in Hadahedi plus Ayurveda/homeopathy facilities in Sihali Khurd and Sihali Kalan.
Future commitment: pursue a paved main road from Gayasi Ram Swami's house in Sihali Khurd via Parveen Master's house to Sube Singh Panwar's house in Hadahedi.
Future commitment: build a Patwar house so land-related work can be handled locally.
Future commitment: build a farmer service centre for seed, fertilizer and agricultural medicines, and pursue a Jan Aushadhi centre for affordable generic medicines.
Future commitment: build a senior-citizen chaupal with fans and drinking water.
Future commitment: build modular libraries in Hadahedi and Sihali Kalan.
Future commitment: pursue a permanent 24-hour emergency ambulance facility at the health centre.
Official website: abhaysinghsihali.in. WhatsApp helplines: 6367810227 and 9509352067. When sending a contact card, send only the selected line's number.
